title: Big Disappointment
text: Big Disappointment. Thought I'd invest a little more in what I thought was a higher quality kettle, but it didn't last a year under light use. Do yourself a favor and just buy cheap electric kettles, so when they do not hold up, you're not disappointed. This kettle turned out to be a big disappointment.

product_metadata.title: Chef's Choice 6810001 Kettle, 1.7-Liter, Silver
features: ADVANCED – The design includes a concealed heating element that never comes in contact with the water, eliminating the risk of mineral deposits build-up on the heating element.

DESIGN - Handsomely crafted with an elegant brushed stainless steel kettle body and a cool to the touch comfortable handle, the 681 is as pleasing to the eye as it is functional and convenient to use.
CAPACITY - With a generous 1. 75-quart water capacity, the kettle will heat ample amounts of water for hot beverages and effortless food preparation.

CONVENIENT - Serving hot water has never been more convenient with this cordless kettle that lifts from its corded base for easy filling, pouring and serving. The 360 degree cordless swivel design is ideal for right handed or left handed use.
FEATURES - Monitoring and measuring the water level is easy with the kettle’s exterior water gauge located adjacent to the cool touch handle. illuminated light on/off switch.
AUTO SHUTOFF – The kettle will automatically shut off when water boils and its boil dry protection feature will provide years of dependable use.
Cord stores neatly in the base and adjusts to desired length.
110/120V designed exclusively for use in North America. 1500 Watts
description: Handsomely constructed of high-quality brushed stainless steel, this cordless electric kettle offers a 1 3/4-quart water capacity and 1500-watt of power which boils water faster than the stove or microwave oven. This cordless kettle lifts from the corded base for easy filling, pouring and serving with an automatic shut off when water boils. The advanced design of the concealed heating element is never in contact with the water, so there is no buildup of objectionable mineral deposits. For safety, the kettle provides automatic shut-off, boil-dry safety protection, a secure locking lid, power on indicator light and cool touch bottom. Other highlights include a convenient water-level gauge built into the handle and a cord that wraps neatly into the base for easy storage. The teakettle measures 9.2 by 6 by 8-inch and includes a one-year limited warranty.
